work_item_status_summary.name: Work Order Status Summary
work_item_status_summary.description: Work order count grouped by status
work_item_status_summary.query: SELECT wi.status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM work_item wi WHERE wi.company_id = {company_id} GROUP BY wi.status ORDER BY count DESC;

assignee_workload_summary.name: Assignee Workload Summary
assignee_workload_summary.description: Open work orders grouped by assignee
assignee_workload_summary.query: SELECT TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.last_name, ''))) AS assignee_name, COUNT(*) AS open_work_orders FROM work_item wi LEFT JOIN person p ON wi.assignee_id = p.id WHERE wi.company_id = {company_id} AND wi.status IN ('Open', 'In Progress', '0', '1') GROUP BY wi.assignee_id, assignee_name ORDER BY open_work_orders DESC;

overdue_work_orders.name: Overdue Work Orders
overdue_work_orders.description: Open work orders with a scheduled date before today
overdue_work_orders.query: SELECT wi.id, wi.title, wi.priority, wi.scheduled_date, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.last_name, ''))) AS assignee_name FROM work_item wi LEFT JOIN person p ON wi.assignee_id = p.id WHERE wi.company_id = {company_id} AND wi.status IN ('Open', 'In Progress', '0', '1') AND DATE(wi.scheduled_date) < CURDATE() ORDER BY wi.scheduled_date ASC;
